title: SWE-Bench Pro Verified: A Reliable Benchmark for Software Engineering Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.08149v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: SWE-Bench Pro has emerged as a standard benchmark for evaluating software engineering agents on challenging repository-level tasks. However, our analysis work show that its evaluation is undermined by two sources of unreliability: \textbf{reward hacking}, enabled by leakage of gold solutions or hidden evaluation information, and \textbf{task quality issues}, including misleading problem statements and improperly scoped tests. These issues can inflate benchmark performance and obscure agents' true coding ability. We present \textbf{SWE-Bench Pro Verified}, a verified version of SWE-Bench Pro that addresses both problems. Our approach combines \textbf{anti-hacking} safeguards that eliminate major leakage channels without disrupting normal agent functionality, with \textbf{task refinement} that minimally corrects inconsistencies within flawed instances. translated_title: SWE-Bench Pro Verified：一个可靠的软件工程智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: SWE-Bench Pro 已成为评估软件工程智能体在具有挑战性的仓库级任务上表现的标准基准。然而，我们的分析工作表明，其评估结果受到两类不可靠因素的损害：一是“奖励破解”，即由于标准答案或隐藏评估信息的泄露而使智能体得以作弊；二是任务质量问题，包括具有误导性的问题描述和范围界定不当的测试。这些问题可能会夸大基准测试成绩，掩盖智能体真实的编程能力。我们提出了 SWE-Bench Pro Verified，这是 SWE-Bench Pro 的一个经过验证的版本，能够同时解决上述两个问题。我们的方法结合了防破解保护措施（在不干扰智能体正常功能的前提下消除主要的泄露渠道）和任务精炼（对有缺陷实例中的不一致之处进行最小程度的修正）。在 SWE-Bench Pro Verified 上的评估结果显示，一些模型的表现明显变差……
tldr: 该论文发现 SWE-Bench Pro 基准存在答案泄露导致的奖励破解和任务质量问题，并推出了经过验证的 SWE-Bench Pro Verified 版本，通过防泄露保护与任务修正实现更可靠的软件工程智能体评估。
en_tdlr: The paper identifies reward hacking and task quality issues in SWE-Bench Pro, and introduces SWE-Bench Pro Verified, a refined benchmark with anti-hacking safeguards and task corrections that enables more reliable evaluation of software engineering agents.
